name: carbon-arc-talent-intelligence
description: Analyze talent (musicians and actors) with Carbon Arc data. Built to keep you in control: iterate and explore as you normally would, or ask it to run straight through. One report: an audience intelligence brief for talent management, agencies and labels. Try: "Build a brief on [artist or actor]." "Who are [artist]'s real peers?" "Which cities pay the most to see [artist] live?"
